caption: The drawing depicts a section of a wooden railing or balustrade set on a surface that resembles brownish tiles. The railing consists of two central panels, each painted in a light bluish-green color, with four evenly spaced turned balusters inside each panel. These central panels are framed by columns of a similar color with vertical pink veining. On either side of the panels, there are two pairs of thicker, wavy wooden balusters in a natural brown wood tone, each pair connected by a pink and yellow circular decorative element. The top of the balustrade features a dark brown or black rail, and the structure appears symmetrical. The background is plain and cream-colored with no additional features or scenery. The artist's signature, "Bicheley," appears in red in the lower right corner.
title: Chancel Railing
